description: Use this when the user has two versions of a spreadsheet and wants a summary rather than a full list: "how many prices went up", "which columns changed the most", "biggest changes between these two files", "average price increase". Returns counts (changed, added, removed rows), per-column statistics (cells changed, increases, decreases, total and average percent change, largest increase and decrease) and the biggest single changes, with the same Excel and CSV downloads. Use compare_spreadsheets for the row-by-row list. Does not forecast or explain why values changed.

column_map.description: Old column name -> new column name for renamed columns, e.g. {"Unit Price": "Price (USD)"}. Turns off automatic rename detection.

compare_numbers_as_values.description: Compare numbers by value so "1,200.00" equals 1200, e.g. true (default). Codes with leading zeros (00123) stay text.

compare_row_numbers.description: Compare a running row-number column (#, Row, No.: 1, 2, 3...) like any other column, e.g. true. Default false: it shifts whenever a row is inserted, so it is skipped with a note.

detect_key_changes.description: Report a removed row and an added row whose other values are identical as one key change (e.g. a SKU renumbered), e.g. true (default).

header_row_new.description: Row number of the column headings in the new file, e.g. 3.

header_row_old.description: Row number of the column headings in the old file when it is not detected, e.g. 3 when two title rows come first.

ignore_case.description: Treat ABC and abc as equal, e.g. true. Default false.

ignore_columns.description: Columns to leave out of the comparison, e.g. ["Last updated", "Notes"].

key_columns.description: Column(s) that identify a row, to override the automatic key, e.g. ["SKU"] or ["Store", "Product code"].

new_file.description: The NEWER version (CSV, TSV or Excel .xlsx), e.g. pricelist_2026Q4.xlsx or roster-october.csv.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

new_sheet.description: Sheet (tab) to read from the new workbook, e.g. Prices Q4.

new_table.description: Instead of new_file: the newer version pasted as CSV/TSV text with a header row, e.g. "SKU,Price\nA1,10.50\nC3,7.00".

normalize_dates.description: Compare dates by calendar day, so 2026-03-05, 3/5/2026 and an Excel date serial are equal, e.g. true (default).

numeric_tolerance.description: Numbers that differ by this much or less count as equal, e.g. 0.01 to ignore rounding by a cent. Default 0.

old_file.description: The OLDER version (CSV, TSV or Excel .xlsx), e.g. pricelist_2026Q3.xlsx or roster-september.csv.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

old_sheet.description: Sheet (tab) to read from the old workbook, e.g. Prices Q3. Default: the sheet with the same name as in the new workbook, else the first sheet with data.

old_table.description: Instead of old_file: the older version pasted as CSV/TSV text with a header row, e.g. "SKU,Price\nA1,10.00\nB2,5.00".

trim_whitespace.description: Ignore leading/trailing and repeated spaces, e.g. true (default).

name: summarize_changes

unit.description: pp: delta is in percentage points (percent columns)

title: Summarize changes
